name: Digital Talk Series 2 "Haruka"
original_name: でじたるとーくシリーズ２ 「はるか」
source:
2nd issue of Digital Talk Series. Enjoy her cloth-changing & sweet talk. Haruka is my junior of highschool, and is very cute boyish bishoujo.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007445.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Digital Talk系列第二作。和她一起享受换装与甜蜜对话吧。Haruka是我的高中学妹，十分可爱，是位带有少年气质的美少女。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ007445.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
